payload.name: Germane cognitive load mediation
payload.fact: Germane cognitive load mediates the relationship between virtual simulation technology (VST) and learning outcomes in accounting education.

provenance.title: THE INFLUENCE MECHANISM OF VIRTUAL SIMULATION TECHNOLOGY ON INTERMEDIATE FINANCIAL ACCOUNTING LEARNING OUTCOMES: A COGNITIVE PSYCHOLOGY PERSPECTIVE
